Based on the provided abstract, the candidate hypothesis introduces specific elements not mentioned or supported in the evidence—such as "area-weighted assessments," an "advanced multivariable integrated skill score (MISS) tailored to specific scalar and vector fields," and "defined performance thresholds." Furthermore, the candidate hypothesis entirely omits the study's central focus on evaluating model interdependency and clustering to balance model performance with model independence to maintain a reasonable inter-model spread.

VERDICT: REJECT
